name: UC Davis Strawberry Breeding Program
aliases: University of California, Davis Strawberry Breeding Program
description: Public strawberry breeding program at the University of California, Davis. Ended its strawberry licensing agreements with Eurosemillas in 2024. Former program breeder Douglas Shaw left to found California Berry Cultivars, which Driscoll's later sued for patent infringement, alleging Driscoll's proprietary germplasm was used in CBC's breeding; a jury initially sided with UC Davis in a related breeding-rights trial, and CBC won summary judgment against Driscoll's in district court in 2025 (Driscoll's has appealed).

attributes.notable_former_breeder: Douglas Shaw (departed to found California Berry Cultivars)
